text:
The bowl looks like a mixing bowl, roughly 25 cm across at the rim. The food fills a small area of about 9 by 8 cm in the center.

It looks like diced cooked chicken breast with about 9 kalamata olives. The chicken is roughly 30 pieces of about 2 cm each. At about 2 g per piece that comes to roughly 60 g, so I'll say 60–70 g. The olives weigh about 4 g each, so about 9 olives is around 36 g.

Total mass is about 100 g.

Energy: 65 g of chicken at about 1.65 kcal/g is roughly 107 kcal. 36 g of olives at about 1.5 kcal/g is roughly 54 kcal. That gives about 160 kcal, and I'll allow a little for oil, so about 170 kcal.
